population.market: US listed equities and ETF benchmark SPY
population.core_universe: 40 DoltHub tickers present on all five anchor dates
population.secondary_universe: 10 additional recent-covered tickers with partial history, analyzed separately
population.survivorship_policy: No current-index-only inference; departed and delisted names are required before production promotion.

discovery.allowed_use: Specification checks and initial estimation only

validation.allowed_use: One confirmation pass after discovery freeze

availability_policy.options: Use provider availableAt and snapshotId. Unknown timezone or OI freshness is flagged and never silently treated as synchronized EOD.
availability_policy.fundamentals: Use SEC filing acceptance or first-filed date, never period-end as availability.
availability_policy.events: Use actual earnings/filing disclosure timestamp and separate pre-open from post-close events.
availability_policy.returns: Forward returns begin strictly after signal availability; adjusted prices and SPY use the same calendar.

dolthub_options.role: Mid-DTE IV/Greeks research panel; not a full-chain source
limitations: Four-expiration sample in the latest probe

hf_options_iv_sp500.role: Aggregated IV, call/put volume and OI proxy through 2023-07-28
limitations: License and provenance review required before redistribution

cboe_forward.role: Full current delayed chains for forward validation
limitations: One to three snapshots per ticker at protocol creation

historicaldata_sample.role: Full-schema loader and QA validation only

sec_prices.role: Adjusted underlying and SPY returns from the reviewed local price panel
limitations: Corporate-action and departed-name expansion remains a production gate

edgar_events.role: Official filing timestamps and earnings-event evidence
limitations: Event semantics must be separated from acceptance time
Vintage and revision limitations must be logged

all_option_sources.role: Combined option evidence only after source-specific tests
limitations: Weakest material source determines the claim grade

base_engine_factors.role: Existing fundamentals, tone, smart-money and macro engine inputs

signed_trade_volume.role: Aggressor-side and buy-to-open trade volume required for informed-flow tests
limitations: Not present in Cboe delayed chains, DoltHub, Hugging Face or current normalized samples
No second-order Greeks or dealer-position sign in current sources

inference_policy.primary_estimator: Cross-sectional Spearman rank IC or the hypothesis-specific paired metric
inference_policy.uncertainty: Moving block bootstrap confidence intervals respecting time and cross-sectional dependence
inference_policy.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the 20 predeclared primary endpoints
inference_policy.secondary_results: Exploratory only; never promoted by selecting the best horizon, sign, universe or DTE bucket

robustness_grid.rule: Change one dimension per run; label interactions separately and retain every failed run
robustness_grid.verdict_rule: Grade the weakest material slice, never only the mean or the best run

implementation_policy.default_mode: Research only; no production signals or orders
implementation_policy.equity_costs: Report gross and net evidence with spread, impact and borrow scenarios where implementable
implementation_policy.option_costs: Use contract-level spread, multiplier, contract volume/OI, multi-leg and assignment/exercise rules before any option-PnL claim
implementation_policy.missing_values: Remain null; no fabricated chains, OI, events or history

hypotheses.primary_metric: cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of ATM IV versus forward realized volatility
hypotheses.target: Forward realized volatility; no equity-return sign
hypotheses.falsifier: IC confidence interval includes zero on validation and the sign reverses on holdout.

hypotheses.primary_metric: coverage error and MAE of option-implied expected move versus absolute forward return
hypotheses.target: Absolute forward return and interval calibration
hypotheses.falsifier: Expected move does not improve calibration over a trailing-RV baseline on validation.

hypotheses.primary_metric: cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of mid-DTE term slope versus forward realized volatility
hypotheses.target: Near-term event stress and forward realized volatility
hypotheses.falsifier: Inversion has no forward-RV information on validation or the effect is confined to one year.

hypotheses.primary_metric: cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of IV-minus-trailing-RV versus forward realized volatility
hypotheses.target: Forward RV and volatility risk premium
hypotheses.falsifier: The premium does not forecast forward RV after controlling for trailing RV and VIX.

hypotheses.primary_metric: paired median IV_after/IV_before minus one with block-bootstrap confidence interval
hypotheses.target: Matched pre/post earnings IV change
hypotheses.falsifier: Median crush is non-negative or the paired interval includes zero on validation.

hypotheses.primary_metric: two-sided cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of 25-delta skew change versus SPY-excess forward return
hypotheses.target: Left-tail risk and forward excess return
hypotheses.falsifier: Both directional forms fail validation, or the sign is unstable across independent universes.

hypotheses.primary_metric: two-sided cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of put/call volume versus SPY-excess forward return
hypotheses.target: Positioning and forward return; U-shape is secondary
hypotheses.falsifier: Neither bearish nor contrarian form survives validation and FDR control.

hypotheses.primary_metric: two-sided cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of put/call open interest versus SPY-excess forward return
hypotheses.target: Structural hedging and forward return
hypotheses.falsifier: No stable sign survives OI availability checks and independent universes.

hypotheses.primary_metric: cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of volume/open-interest turnover versus forward realized volatility
hypotheses.target: Information arrival and forward realized volatility
hypotheses.falsifier: Turnover adds no forward-RV information after liquidity and zero-volume filters.

hypotheses.primary_metric: net signal degradation and execution rejection rate across ATM spread buckets
hypotheses.target: Execution feasibility, not standalone alpha
hypotheses.falsifier: Spread filtering does not improve net evidence or rejects only immaterial observations.

hypotheses.primary_metric: feature stability and coverage loss across zero-bid buckets
hypotheses.target: Data quality and Greek reliability
hypotheses.falsifier: Zero-bid filtering changes no material feature or removes only unusable rows.

hypotheses.primary_metric: Brier_base minus Brier_base+options and LogLoss_base minus LogLoss_base+options
hypotheses.target: Incremental probability quality and calibration
hypotheses.falsifier: Deltas are non-positive on validation or calibration degrades on sealed holdout.

hypotheses.primary_metric: cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of signed call ask volume versus SPY-excess forward return
hypotheses.target: Informed aggressive call buying and forward return
hypotheses.falsifier: Signed volume adds no value over unsigned put/call volume after realistic costs and independent universes.

hypotheses.primary_metric: expiration-day absolute PinDist and close clustering versus matched non-expiration sessions
hypotheses.target: Expiration-day price clustering near maximum total OI strike
hypotheses.falsifier: No excess clustering relative to matched non-expiration sessions after liquidity controls.

hypotheses.primary_metric: cross-sectional Spearman rank IC of deep-tail skew change versus downside semivariance and SPY-excess return
hypotheses.target: Left-tail risk beyond standard 25-delta skew
hypotheses.falsifier: Deep-tail skew adds no information over the existing 25-delta skew on validation.

hypotheses.primary_metric: paired change in IV-minus-RV compression versus event-window absolute return and realized volatility
hypotheses.target: Underpriced event movement independent of direction
hypotheses.falsifier: Compression adds no value after term-slope, event-type and trailing-RV controls.

hypotheses.primary_metric: change in risk-neutral left-tail probability versus forward tail return and trend change
hypotheses.target: Tail-risk and trend information beyond skew
hypotheses.falsifier: Density estimates are unstable across quote filters or add no information beyond skew.

hypotheses.primary_metric: signed Spearman rank IC of dollar Net GEX versus next-day Garman-Klass volatility or absolute log return; expected negative under long-gamma dampening
hypotheses.target: Volatility compression or amplification, not equity direction
hypotheses.falsifier: IC is not negative on validation or the sign is unstable across dealer scenarios and independent universes. Claimed -0.12 to -0.22 ranges are not acceptance criteria.

hypotheses.primary_metric: intraday realized-volatility response to IV changes and time decay around expirations
hypotheses.target: Second-order hedging pressure and intraday volatility
hypotheses.falsifier: Not testable without second-order Greeks and an explicit dealer-position model.

hypotheses.primary_metric: conditional reversal probability and signed forward return when |WallDist| ≤ 1%
hypotheses.target: Gamma-wall proximity and short-horizon reversal
hypotheses.falsifier: No excess reversal relative to matched non-wall sessions or direction unstable across dealer scenarios.
